scope: round-2 repair diff plus standing findings — not a fresh full-diff sweep
circuit_breaker: ARMED, DID NOT TRIP. Three times earlier in this queue a repair introduced the defect class it was fixing, so round 3's primary question was whether round 2's repair did it a fourth time. The reviewer's determination is NO, established by measurement rather than by absence of evidence: the R7 bound timed at 2.00s on a non-matching locator with a `None` box landing in the same degrade path; R9's `false` assertion shown structural rather than incidental; the rebase union proven complete at 2190 rows with zero main rows missing; the ceiling filter confirmed to exclude #67's rows by count (84 and 229 cannot enter a 238-count band); no closed-world regression.
text_provenance: Same constraint as rounds 1 and 2, filed as M43-D4: groundwork:pr-reviewer has tools Read/Grep/Glob/Bash and NO message tool, so its findings array could not be returned to the orchestrator that spawned it. Transcribed from the orchestrator-channel relay of the reviewer's terminal message. Recorded as a RELAY, not the reviewer's own bytes.

findings.claim: The R10 text repair was PARTIAL: the falsified origin-arithmetic justification was corrected in two places and left verbatim at five sibling sites, including the INDEX.md digest a reader opens first.
findings.evidence: R10's rule was 'the published reason must become true' — but it becomes true only where it is published, and it is published in six places. Survivors included specs/decisions/INDEX.md's ADR-035 digest and the code comments at both `vision[0]` assignment sites.
findings.repro: grep the falsified sentence ('its origin is the element's bounding box, so a coordinate read off it lands somewhere else entirely') and its paraphrases across specs/, src/, README.
findings.acceptance: Every published instance corrected, the site count reported, and any deliberate survivor explicitly declared as model-facing guidance rather than published rationale.

findings.claim: The R8 sweep was PARTIAL: it re-typed the stale number it was hunting and left three neighbouring clauses in the same paragraph contradicting the ledger committed beside them.
findings.evidence: A published band that drops rows — PR #29 R21's class. Ungraded here because `published-band-matches-the-ledger` reads only the Band-source bullet, so the contradicting clauses stay green indefinitely.
findings.repro: Read the three clauses against the 238-count rows in evals/report/history.jsonl.
findings.acceptance: All three clauses re-derived from the committed ledger. The conclusion (case-count growth, not per-case cost) is unaffected; only the numbers are wrong.

findings.claim: ADR-029 is missing its `Amended by` line pointing at ADR-035.
findings.evidence: ADR-029's own `Amends` line records PR #57 R25 finding exactly this omission in ADR-021 — the file did to its successor what its predecessor had done to it, and documented the defect in the same breath.
findings.repro: Read ADR-029's header block for an Amended-by entry naming ADR-035.
findings.acceptance: The link added; the recursion is a better argument for grading the link than any assertion.

findings.claim: The degenerate drill shape is described as an element 'at least as large as' the viewport, when the condition is one that COVERS the viewport in both axes.
findings.evidence: M43-D6's own repro already states the covering condition correctly, so the prose and the repro disagreed inside one block.
findings.repro: Compare M43-D6's Spec prose against its Repro line.
findings.acceptance: Prose agrees with the repro everywhere the shape is described.

findings.claim: `_shot_ok`'s `"viewport"` branch tests the label alone and no area, so the grader's authority is one-directional.
findings.evidence: The strict inequality catches an element frame that is secretly a viewport shot; nothing catches a viewport frame that is secretly a crop.
findings.acceptance: The one-directional ceiling recorded in M43-D6's block, in the same sentence that declares the grader authoritative. Widening the grader is deliberately NOT done in this round.
